note: push_box at the smallest scale (a plumbing check, not training): 2 teacher episodes from reset, 1 probe scene + 1 training scene, one round of 2 starts x 8 candidates and one update step; acceleration switches at their defaults (rows 1, full rendering). Acceleration: rows only changes throughput (starts, candidates, seeds, samples per round and gradient batches are unchanged); row-batched and row-by-row sampling agree only to bf16 rounding, so trajectories are not bit-identical (with rows 1 every candidate rebuilds its start history on its own, which is much slower). render_mode sampled gives bit-identical policy frames. rows, learn_batch and render_mode may change when a run resumes.
